summary: Tested all 8 requested areas. Backend tests ran in disposable isolated DBs. The UI was checked through a disposable bridge (tests/ui_bridge187.py on 127.0.0.1:8770, with /api routed through Playwright). The preview DB was only read; nothing was written to it. 1) Clickable PDF counts work. Detected/Complete/Held/Published/Scheduled are buttons with aria-pressed. Held shows only held mocks, with 'Showing 1 held mock.' and 'Show all 1'. Clicking the same count again or 'Show all' clears the filter. Complete/Published give the right empty or one-row results. 'Pages read' is not a button. Clicking a count from the Fix panel goes back to the Book map. Mobile 390px works. 2) Public JEE series: 2026-12-09 to 2027-01-27, total 50, 50 slots. Streak: total_days 50, last cup 50 'Champion', policy says 'After 27 January', no 62. Master owner view shows 50 days. Studio assign outside the range returns 422 with the exact message. Master assign on the old day 2026-12-05 returns 422. Changing the builtin series days returns 409 mentioning 50 days. 3) Migration jee_dates_once in an isolated DB: (a) loses series_id/date/window/start_at/end_at, stays published + series_import, appears in Master candidates and is hidden from students; (b) keeps 2026-12-20; (c) the pending mock gets series_date None and publish_requested False. The series doc becomes 12-09/50, the state is done with moved 2, and a second run returns None and changes nothing. A read-only check of the preview DB shows the migration done (moved 0) and the series doc at 12-09/50. 4) Owner early access works for JEE and for a custom (BITSAT-like) series. Owner gets early true, can_start true, set_id and the real title. Student and anonymous users get the placeholder 'All India JEE Mains · Test 02' with set_id null. Owner GET /api/my/sets/<id> (the path the UI uses) returns 200; student gets 404. Owner start gives mode series_live with competition_end at 11:59 PM of that day, stored on the attempt. Student start before the day returns 404/409. 5) UI: the owner sees series-owner-early with 'EARLY · ONLY YOU' and 'Start now · only you' linking to /sets/<id>; clicking it opens the set's check-and-start page. Students do not see the section. Hub dates, 'The 50-day schedule', the Home banner texts, the 50 DAYS counter and the explainer title '50 days. One focused mission.' all match. No '62' on Home, hub or Landing. 6) series-exam-cards is absent on /home and /. The exam catalog aits section has series_path /series/<sid> and live_count 0; jee-main has /series/all-india-jee. The ExamHub card links there and the BITSAT series page opens. The Master toggle reads 'Open to students' with the inside-exam note, and the toast says 'Students can now open it inside its exam.' 7) Lock held 5 s: Give a day waited and returned 200, and the paper was built. Lock held 36 s: 409 with the exact 'This PDF is still finishing earlier work...' message after about 30 s, and the mock was untouched. 8) Regression: forgot_pin_iso184 53/53, retest_iso186 17/17. typed_delete_iso185 failed 4 tests at first only because its fixture used day 2026-12-02, which is now outside the series; after moving the fixture date to 2026-12-12 it passes 54/54.

minor.issue: Uses phase(day, t) and window(day) and ignores the set's stored series_window, while series_admin.slots uses series_window. Harmless today because JEE windows always equal the default JEE times, but the two schedule endpoints could disagree if a JEE paper ever has a custom window. Seen with a test fixture whose window was shifted to 'open now': it showed as early/upcoming on the hub.

The owner gets 404 for an early series paper because this route never passes the user. The UI uses /api/my/sets/{id}, which returns 200, so this does not affect the owner flow. Only a concern if anything links to the anonymous route.
lock_book_waiting can wait up to 30 s per busy book, one book after another, so a fill over several busy books could run past the ingress/request timeout. Consider a single overall time budget.

ui_bugs.issue: The rule '.book-metric.is-filter span::after' added an arrow to every nested span. In preview the visual-edit wrapper spans sit inside <strong> and the label, so it showed '1 →' and 'DETECTED → →'. FIXED by changing it to '> span::after'.

issues: Already there before this change: '.book-metrics span{font-size:12px}' also applies to the wrapper span inside <strong>, so the count numbers (and '2 / 2') show at 12px instead of 30px in preview. Scope it to '.book-metric > span'.
The active filter uses teal fallbacks (#0f766e / --brand-soft) on the red/dark theme, which looks slightly off-brand.
The '50 DAYS' counter on the right looks small and widely spaced in a desktop screenshot taken 2.5 s after load. May be mid-animation; worth a visual check.

action_items: Optional: make live_series.schedule_data use set_window(s) for state, to match series_admin.slots
Optional: scope '.book-metrics span' font-size to direct children so the count numbers render at 30px
Optional: give lock_book_waiting in fill a single overall time budget across books
critical_code_review_comments: Owner early access is role-based (role=='owner'), not tied to abhishek@billpe.com. The preview DB has exactly 1 owner, so this matches the request today.
jee_dates_job relies on unassign_set, which keeps status published + series_import. Students are protected by content.permitted (series_import without series_date is hidden). Verified.
Master candidates only lists built sets with catalog_section_id == the series section or a book_import_id. Real built papers have these; hand-made fixtures need catalog_section_id='jee-main:aits'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (47/47 new + 124/124 regression after fixture date update)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 cosmetic CSS bug fixed
